headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $60,000 as Tech Stock Rally Fades
summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 as market momentum following Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia waned. Nasdaq 100 futures slid about 1%, while the US Dollar Index traded above 104.
why: Bitcoin and technology equities often trade synchronously as investors adjust global risk exposure across speculative and growth assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices broke below the $60,000 technical support level.
